raw_response: {"diagnosis": "About 60 rows in raw_customers carry numeric region codes ('01'-'04') instead of region names. silver_customers passes these through unchanged, which breaks the region domain and splits gold_region_daily. raw_region_map gives a complete one-to-one mapping (01=WEST, 02=EAST, 03=NORTH, 04=SOUTH), so the codes can be translated to names.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, upper(coalesce(m.region_name, c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON trim(c.region) = trim(m.region_code)"}}
